text:
I built the animated bar chart in the Main comp (1920×1080, 6 s, white background).

- **Title:** "Revenue by quarter" (**title**) with a grey subline "Quarterly revenue, $M" (**subtitle**), both fading and rising in at the top left, inside the title-safe area.
- **Axis:** **axis** draws in from the left at 0.2 s, before any bars.
- **Bars:** **q1** to **q4** grow up from the baseline, 0.15 s apart (0.9, 1.05, 1.2, 1.35 s), with Quart Out easing. Heights are proportional to 12, 18, 15, 27.
- **Values:** **v1** to **v3** fade and rise into place just after each bar lands. **v4** (27) springs in larger and blue.
- **Highlight:** Q4 (**q4**) is the only blue bar, with the value and the "Q4" label in the same blue. The other bars are light grey. Q4 gets a small extra pop: it overshoots to 104% at 2.25 s and settles at 2.55 s.
- **Quarter labels:** **x1** to **x4** fade in under the baseline.

The critic scored it 80/100. Its main note is that nothing moves after 2.55 s, so the last 3.5 s are a static hold. I left it static so the chart stays easy to read. If you want motion there, I can add a slow push on the whole chart.

I also moved the quarter labels up slightly to stay inside the bottom safe margin. The value labels are fade-ins, not counting numbers. I can switch them to count up from 0 if you prefer.
